kpis.description_fr: Revenu par hl FY24. Indicateur clé pricing+premiumization. Croissance forte grâce mix premium (Corona, Stella, Michelob ULTRA) + hausses prix.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Beyond-Beer (seltzers, RTD, cocktails) + No/Low alcohol FY24. Croissance double-digit, réponse santé/wellness. Corona Cero #1 NoLo.
kpis.description_en: Beyond-Beer (seltzers, RTD, cocktails) + No/Low alcohol revenue FY24. Double-digit growth, health/wellness response. Corona Cero #1 NoLo.

kpis.description_en: BEES B2B platform GMV (digital orders bars/restos) FY24. 70%+ digital revenue, 3rd-party marketplace adjacent.

kpis.description_fr: Volume bière vendu FY24 (millions d'hectolitres). #1 mondial loin devant Heineken/Carlsberg. Légère baisse, pricing positif compense.
kpis.description_en: Beer volume sold FY24 (million hectoliters). #1 globally far ahead of Heineken/Carlsberg. Slight decline, positive pricing offsets.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu marques globales (Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Michelob ULTRA) FY24. Cœur premium, marges supérieures.
kpis.description_en: Global brand revenue (Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Michelob ULTRA) FY24. Premium core, higher margins.

kpis_story.description_fr: Mai 2023 boycott Bud Light US suite controverse marketing. Perte ~$1Md ventes US 2023-2024. Stabilisation fin 2024, reprise progressive 2025. Michelob ULTRA #1 US désormais.
kpis_story.description_en: May 2023 Bud Light US boycott after marketing controversy. ~$1Bn US sales loss 2023-2024. Stabilization end 2024, gradual recovery 2025. Michelob ULTRA now #1 US.

_notes: Largest global brewer. Source: 20-F FY24 filed Mar 2025.
